tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original reusable children's educational character poses, directly based on sole attached adopted Darwin's fox identity/style reference, not a pixel edit. Preserve this exact character's colours and asymmetric colour patches, short bipedal character anatomy, head/trunk/ear/tail proportions and warm brown contour/paint texture. Preserve original exact white eyes with plain brown pupils, no white sparkle highlights. Keep existing forepaw/toe designs and counts, not extra human fingers. No new pale palms, pads or claws; retain original reference paw colours. Same head and full standing torso proportions in all poses. Do not make a squat/smaller redesign.
Composition: square3072x3072 transparent RGBA canvas with TWO full-body complete characters, one in each of two equal VERTICAL cells side-by-side in a single row. Each tall cell is half the full canvas width and full height. Leave generous transparent gutter between them; no visible divider. Maximize native character pixels while preserving every ear/tail tip and raised paw. Use one identical anatomical head/torso scale for both; never fit one pose independently.
1. LEFT cell: think — Gentle curious pondering, one original paw near cheek, subtle head tilt, original eye format.
2. RIGHT cell: aha — Quiet discovery, original open eyes and small CLOSED curved smile, one original forepaw slightly raised, absolutely no external rays/symbols/effects.
Constraints: genuine transparency with generated alpha, no ground, shadows, text, labels, grid, symbols, effect rays, sparkles or ANY added objects. Do not add mouth opening, tongue or tooth changes; original closed friendly mouth. No new clothes, highlights, limbs, pads or disconnected parts. Crisp native contours and clean soft painted paper surfaces, no messy lumps, bleeding or blur. This character is required at its existing large use size, so prioritize native figure resolution rather than small drawings in empty cells.
